title: Uber quietly launched Uber Kids as a pilot in three US cities for kids as young as 10, building on its teen ride-hailing service for those aged 13 to 17 (Kirsten Korosec/TechCrunch)
summary: Kirsten Korosec / TechCrunch: Uber quietly launched Uber Kids as a pilot in three US cities for kids as young as 10, building on its teen ride-hailing service for those aged 13 to 17 — Uber has opened its ride-hailing service to children as young as 10 in three U.S. cities as the company tests whether there's a market …
